dedupe_keys.name: reconstructed county level dataset of crop areas affected by typhoons in china s coastal regions 1980 2022

description: Reconstructed county-level dataset of crop areas affected by typhoons in China’s coastal regions (1980–2022) is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Wenjing Wang et al. The scarcity of long-term, high-resolution typhoon disaster data, particularly for agricultural metrics, poses significant challenges for stable typhoon agricultural disaster risk modeling, limiting predictive accuracy. To address this critical issue, we reconstructed a county-level dataset of typhoon-affected crop areas across China’s coastal regions (Shandong, Jiangsu, Shanghai, Zhejiang, Fujian, Guangdong, Guangxi and Hainan) from 1980 to 2022. Coverage: national (CN); published in 2025. Formats: Excel. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 18644224 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
